Hill Air Force Base.note: Federal civilian and military positions are excluded from LEHD wage records (not UI-covered employment). Only private contractor jobs appear in this dataset, significantly underrepresenting actual commute volumes to this site.

Ogden Valley City.note: Incorporated in 2025, after the Census place geography used by LEHD. Boundary is UGRC's municipal boundary and is applied to all years; it covers the former Eden, Liberty and Wolf Creek CDPs plus adjacent unincorporated Weber County.
